items.title: Vampire Riding a Bicycle
items.alt: A smiling vampire boy rides a teal bicycle with both hands on the handlebars and a short red-lined cape behind him.
items.description: A smiling vampire boy rides a teal bicycle with both hands on the handlebars and a short red-lined cape behind him. Useful for movement story cards.

items.title: Vampire Picking an Apple
items.alt: A red-haired vampire reaches for one of three apples on a small potted tree while holding an empty basket.
items.description: A red-haired vampire reaches for one of three apples on a small potted tree while holding an empty basket. Useful for autumn story prompts.

items.title: Vampire Adjusting a Telescope
items.alt: A vampire with a small silver streak in his hair leans toward a short blue telescope on a sturdy tripod.
items.description: A vampire with a small silver streak in his hair leans toward a short blue telescope on a sturdy tripod. Useful for night-sky activities.
